summary: Walks the element array at this+0x10 (count this+0x0C, 120-byte stride) and flips a Bit12 flag on each element's target object. In conditional mode (a2 == 0) the flag is cleared when the element's completion predicate (signed +112 > 0 and the float reached through +116 == 99999.0) matches the pending byte at +2, and set when they disagree. In clear-all mode (a2 != 0) every element with a valid object at +100 has its flag cleared unconditionally. Called per-frame by PitStopOperationTimer (004a6340) and PitStopProgress (004a68b0).

local_names.this: container holding the element count at +0x0C and the element-array base pointer at +0x10
local_names.a2: mode selector: zero selects the conditional branch, non-zero selects the forced clear-all branch
local_names.v3: loop counter compared against the count at this+0x0C
local_names.i: byte offset into the 120-byte-stride element array
local_names.v11: element-array base pointer read from this+0x10
local_names.v12: state/index dword at element+72, -1 marks a dead element
local_names.v14: target object pointer at element+100, cleared/set when valid

operations.description: a2 == 0 selects the conditional per-element mode; a non-zero a2 forces the clear-all mode that skips the conditional branch entirely
Iterates the element array at this+0x10 with a 120-byte stride, once per element of the count stored at this+0x0C, stopping when the counter reaches the count
Per-element skip: elements whose dword at +72 equals -1, or whose target pointer at +100 is null, are skipped without any flag change

Conditional flag decision: BitClear is applied to the object at +100 when the completion predicate (int +112 > 0 and float pointed by +116 == 99999.0) equals the pending byte at +2, otherwise Bit12FlagSet is applied
Clear-all mode walks the same array and unconditionally BitClear-s the object at +100 for every element whose +72 dword is not -1 and whose target pointer is non-null
Returns the final element count read from this+0x0C
